title.rendered: Word of the Day : YOU’RE COMING BACK

excerpt.rendered: “…and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.” (Ezekiel 37: 10) That is the Focal Scripture…

content.rendered:
“…and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an
exceeding great army.”
(Ezekiel 37: 10)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

When the hand of the Lord brought Ezekiel to the valley, it was full of bones; but
eventually, the dry bones came back to life. When a human body is reduced to bones,
there is no hope; the case is beyond redemption. No human discussion can bring a dry
bone back to life, but in our Focal Scripture, the dry bones came back to life. They
were finished, but God brought them back to life.

Friend, hear God’s prophetic word: you’re coming back. You are coming out of the
graves men pushed you into; you are coming out of every health challenge that has
reduced you; you are coming out of every hopeless situation that has caused men to
mock you.

You are coming out of every destiny sabotage that happened to you; you are coming
out of every challenge that has reduced you to nothing; you are coming out of every
setback that has pushed you down.

The dry bones may have been forgotten, their case may have been closed, but God
brought them back. It doesn’t matter if men have forgotten you. Your case may have
been closed, but God says, you are coming back. Men may have written you off, but
you are coming back.

Those who murdered the men in the valley of dry bones may have done their worst; but
at God’s time, He raised the men back to life. Relax, God is on the way; He will
raise you in places where you were buried.

Even if people have done their worst, you will bounce back; God will bring the
miracles of restoration with compensation.

Micah 7 vs. 8 says: “Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall
arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.”

Pray With Me: Lord, raise me from places where I was buried; I’m coming back, in
Jesus’ name!
